package.name: inmoov_description
package.description: InMoov robot URDF/meshes for RViz2 comparison against the physical robot (geometry/topology check). Model (description/inmoov_i2.urdf) generated via LinkForge, and launch files, both derived in part from a fork of https://github.com/Sentience-Robotics/inmoov_urdf (GPL-3.0) — this workspace drives the robot via inmoov_control, not ros2_control, so no Gazebo/ros2_control bits are included.
